scripts.dev:pages: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist --service QUOTE_API=cogdev-chat-api-development
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.worker.jsonc --env development
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.worker.jsonc --env production
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name cogdev-chat --branch main
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:api && npm run deploy:pages
